name: SuperX
tagline: The personal core (a composer with an LLM writing in your voice, a slot-based scheduler, and basic analytics) is a weekend build, exactly like every scheduler on this list. What you cannot one-shot: X's write API costs real money before your first post goes out, the 10M-post viral library and timing models are proprietary data collected over years, and the engagement automations live in rate-limit and ToS territory that a personal script will get wrong. Full disclosure: SuperX is built by the person who runs this site. The verdict got no mercy anyway.
verdictSummary: KINDA: SuperX costs $49/mo ($588/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
